audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Bildad's final brief speech: divine dominion/dread, heavenly order, human inability to be righteous/pure, and worm/maggot imagery. Marked as Bildad's speech, not final theology.

verses.restored: Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

familiar.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.restored: Dominion and dread are with him; he makes peace in his heights.

familiar.text: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

modern.text: “Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.

original.text: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו

verses.restored: Is there any number to his troops? Upon whom does his light not rise?

familiar.text: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

modern.text: Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?

original.text: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל מִ֝֗י לֹא יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: How then can a mortal be righteous with the Divine, or one born of woman be clean?

familiar.text: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

modern.text: How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?

original.text: וּמַה יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵ֑ל וּמַה יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה

verses.restored: Look, even the moon is not bright, and the stars are not clean in his eyes;

familiar.text: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

modern.text: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,

original.text: הֵ֣ן עַד יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: how much less a mortal, a worm; and a human, a small creature of the dust.

familiar.text: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

modern.text: how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!”

original.text: אַ֭ף כִּֽי אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה
